name: Lumus Investment Collective
decision_note: Prague-based community of female angel investors that invests deal by deal through SPVs in predominantly CEE startups (e.g. Kardi AI round, April 2025) - an angel network, not a VC fund.

evidence.quote: Lumus Investment Collective is a community of badass women who are actively and eagerly stepping into the angel investing world, smashing the glass ceiling and breaking down gender barriers.
We are a community of investors (not a faceless syndicate) that invests in predominantly CEE-related startups on a deal-by-deal basis.
€3,000 per investment per angel investor is the minimum amount required.
Od stávajících investorů BrightCap Ventures, Depo Ventures a Garage Angels a nově také od Lumus Investment Collective i nejmenovaného českého andělského investora získal celkem 28 milionů korun.

analyst_notes: Quick exclusion dossier (S1, angel network). The own site describes a community of 500+ (predominantly female) angels who receive deal proposals and invest deal by deal through a Special Purpose Vehicle formed for each deal (e2); minimum EUR 3,000 per angel per deal (e3, a member minimum, not a per-company ticket). ARES shows the organiser Lumus Investment Collective s.r.o. (2021, Praha 5) and SPVs Lumus II, III, V and VI s.r.o. at the same address. Activity is current: Kardi AI ('Kardiolog v kapse') round of CZK 28m (CzechCrunch 2025-04-28, e4); the portfolio page also lists HTG Medical, CloseRocket, Aleet, IRAYE (invested 2025) and ArtMaster (2026) with year-only dates. CB Insights types it 'Angel Investor (Group)'.
